description: Lean AgentOps: inyección de reglas del Elefante en SessionStart y sensor silencioso Goldfish fuera de banda

hooks.command: _D="${TAS_PROJECT_DIR:-${LEAN_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}}"; if [ -d "$_D/.tas" ] || [ -d "$_D/.lean_observer" ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}/scripts/goldfish_sensor.py" --platform claude --event PostToolUse; else printf '{}\n'; fi

_D="${TAS_PROJECT_DIR:-${LEAN_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}}"; if [ -d "$_D/.tas" ] || [ -d "$_D/.lean_observer" ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}/scripts/goldfish_sensor.py" --platform claude --event PostToolUseFailure; else printf '{}\n'; fi

_D="${TAS_PROJECT_DIR:-${LEAN_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}}"; if [ -d "$_D/.tas" ] || [ -d "$_D/.lean_observer" ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}/scripts/goldfish_sensor.py" --platform claude --event Stop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
